Package javax.microedition.broadcast.platform Description

This package defines the classes and interfaces to manage the broadcast network provider.

PlatformProvider is the abstraction of the broadcast network provider. PlatformProvider is set by using the PlatformProviderSelector. See its documentation for an overview about platform providers.
